S6-01-default-mount.evidence: 3-pane layout confirmed (sidebar admin + rail buckets + product grid); 21 rail buckets visible across 3 axes (11 item categories + 7 extra groups + 3 variation attributes); default-active = first non-Autres bucket (Sandwich Cayenne, ariaCurrent=true); header rebrand 'Gestion Produits & Stock' + subtitle FR; emojis per category from CATEGORY_ICONS dict; all badges EN STOCK green.

S6-02-product-off.evidence: Toggle Sandwich Cayenne (item_id=22) flipped aria-checked from 'true' to 'false' immediately (optimistic UI); red badge 'RUPTURE' rendered in card (rose-100 bg + rose-800 text); POST /api/admin/menu/availability/toggle returned 200; no rollback observed.

S6-03-refresh-persistence.evidence: After full page reload (waitUntil:domcontentloaded + 2500ms SPA hydration), the same item card's aria-checked still 'false' → server state matches optimistic UI (no desync). DB persistence via item_branch_availability row confirmed indirectly via the catalog-overview returning is_available:false on reload.

S6-04-extra-sauce-off.evidence: Toggle extra 'Boursin' (bucket=stock-mgmt-bucket-extra-other) flipped red. Bulk fan-out POST /api/admin/menu/availability/extra/toggle returned 200 per id (concurrency 2 + 100ms inter-batch delay per M1 round-2 A-005/A-006/A-013 fix).

S6-05-q9s1-sync-proof.method: Empirical cache-key invalidation probe via tinker. Pre-warm 'kiosk.menu.branch.1' (TTL 60s) → trigger admin UI toggle of an extra → poll Cache::has() every 500ms up to 8s.

evidence.rationale: Pre-Q9-S1 fix (a68acb20f), kiosk menu BE cache served stale availability for up to 60s after admin sauce/topping toggle. Post-fix, EventServiceProvider L204-225 wires InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange synchronously to ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged + ItemVariationAvailabilityChanged → Cache::forget() runs in the same request lifecycle. Measured ΔT = 1015ms (well under 5s target) is dominated by HTTP toggle round-trip + Sanctum auth + DB transaction + listener dispatch, NOT cache invalidation latency itself. This proves the sync property end-to-end.

S6-06-variation-off.evidence: Toggle variation 'Frites' (attribute_id=7) flipped red. Bulk fan-out POST /api/admin/menu/availability/variation/toggle returned 200 per underlying variation_id.

S6-07-bulk-5-toggles.evidence: 5 extra-card toggles dispatched nearly simultaneously (Promise.allSettled over click handlers). Because each by-name deduped extra cascades to underlying ItemExtra ids (1..N each), 5 UI toggles fanned out to 16 backend POSTs. Net result: 0 × HTTP 429, 0 × other HTTP errors, 16 × HTTP 200, 4044ms end-to-end (< 10s threshold).
S6-07-bulk-5-toggles.adversarial_pass: Chef rush: 5 toggles in 10s without UI freeze CONFIRMED (no busy spinner stuck, no error toast, no 429).

S6-08-cross-axis-dedupe.evidence: Rail labels confirm M1 round-3 A-015 cross-axis dedupe is operational. Both 'Suppléments' (ItemCategory id=8, 10 items) AND 'Suppléments (à composer)' (extra group_label='supplement', 10 items) render distinctly. 'Suppléments bol' also separate (extra group_label='supplement_bol', 6 items). Total 3 buckets containing 'Suppléments' substring — all visually distinguishable.
S6-08-cross-axis-dedupe.variation_suffix_seen_note: No (cat name) ↔ (variation attribute name) collision exists in current seed → suffix correctly NOT applied (defensive).

S6-09-search-no-match.evidence: Search input 'zzz-nomatch-xyz123' → 0 cards rendered, empty-state visible (data-testid='stock-mgmt-empty'). Search clears immediately on empty input.

S6-10-empty-state.evidence: Post-improvement, empty-state correctly differentiates: 'Aucun produit ne correspond à votre recherche.' (when search active) vs 'Aucun produit dans cette catégorie.' (when bucket genuinely empty). FR-only, polite, accurate.

visual.notes: 3-pane layout balanced, no pane crushed. Toggle UX immediate (optimistic). Status badges color-coded (emerald-100 green / rose-100 red). Long product names (e.g. 'Sauce (1ère Gratuite)') truncate gracefully via 2-line clamp (M1 round-3 A-012 line-clamp regression fix). Le Cayenne header + emojis per category from CATEGORY_ICONS dict. Search input full-width focusable.

dom.notes: data-testid coverage strong (stock-management-v2 root, stock-mgmt-rail nav, stock-mgmt-bucket-<key>, stock-mgmt-toggle-<key>, stock-mgmt-empty, stock-mgmt-search, stock-mgmt-branch-filter, stock-mgmt-read-only, stock-mgmt-error). aria-current='true' on active bucket, aria-checked on switch buttons (role='switch'), aria-busy on the section, aria-live='polite' on error+loading. Disabled state via :disabled + opacity-60 + cursor-wait when toggle in flight.

network.notes: Overview endpoint 200 + body 21KB (bounded). All toggle endpoints 200. Bulk fan-out 16 POSTs in 4s, ZERO 429 (M1 round-2 fix verified). One 401 observed on a probe inside the kiosk fallback path (test artifact, not production behaviour). Echo events broadcast via outbox per EventServiceProvider listeners (verified by sentinel).

console.notes: 2 warnings about WebSocket ws://127.0.0.1:6001 not connecting — local dev has no Soketi/Reverb running, EXPECTED + DOCUMENTED. 1 error 'Failed to load resource 401' from the kiosk-fallback probe — test artifact, not production. Component code itself emits zero errors.

i18n.notes: Zero raw labels detected by sweep regex (admin.stock_mgmt.*, Label.X, kiosk.*, undefined, null EOL). FR-only V1, all keys resolve. Post-improvement: empty_search key added + wired.

a11y.notes: role='switch' + aria-checked on toggle buttons; role='img' + aria-label fallback for read-only; aria-busy on the section; focus-visible:ring-2 ring-emerald-500 on every interactive element; aria-current='true' on active bucket; reduced-motion not yet honored but transitions are minimal (box-shadow 0.15s).

security.notes: All endpoints behind permission:items_show (read) + permission:items_edit (write) middleware. BranchScope enforced; controller uses authorizeBranchScope + authorizeWritableBranchScope. catalogOverview uses withoutGlobalScope explicitly with whereIn branch_id constraint — defensive, branch leakage tested.

performance.notes: Overview endpoint targets ≤5 SELECTs (bulk-query discipline documented in controller PHPDoc). Body size 21KB for full catalog of 45 items + 212 extras + 295 variations. Bulk fan-out concurrency-2 + 100ms gap caps effective rate ~20 RPS while keeping 6-item fan-out under ~400ms end-to-end.

sync_q9s1.notes: Listener wiring sentinel: Q9S1_extra=OK Q9S1_var=OK at runtime. Empirical cache-forget ΔT: 1015ms (target ≤5s, achieved ≤2s end-to-end including HTTP+auth+DB+listener). Frontend Echo subscription onEvents() ItemExtra/ItemVariation/ItemAvailabilityChanged → debouncedReload. Server-side outbox + frontend Echo + kiosk BE cache invalidation = three-layer sync confirmed.

chef_in_rush_5_toggles_in_10s.evidence: S6-07 — 5 UI clicks → 16 backend POSTs → 0 × 429 → 4044ms. Under 10s threshold. No UI freeze, no error toast.

cross_tab_simultaneous_toggles.evidence: AvailabilityService::toggle/toggleExtra/toggleVariation each use Cache::lock with DB transactions + lockForUpdate (per F-016a-BIS comments). Two concurrent toggles on the same row → serialized by lock; on different rows → independent. No test reproduces multi-context UI here, but design is safe.

echo_event_missed_eventual_consistency.evidence: Component installs 60s setInterval polling fallback (this.loadAll on interval) + visibilitychange listener (loadAll on tab-focus). If Echo broadcast lost (network blip), the rail self-heals within 60s polled tick. For branch_id=0 admin, polling is the ONLY mechanism (Echo subscription early-returns when branchId<=0).

improvements_applied.rationale: The bucket-pane empty message 'Aucun produit dans cette catégorie.' was used for BOTH the genuinely-empty bucket case AND the search-no-match case. The latter felt wrong because the bucket has items, the search just excluded them all. Added a new i18n key admin.stock_mgmt.empty_search with FR-only 'Aucun produit ne correspond à votre recherche.' and conditional v-if on searchQuery in the template.

improvements_deferred_to_v1_0_2.concern: WebSocket ws://127.0.0.1:6001 connect warnings in console when no Soketi/Reverb running locally. Production env has Pusher → fine. Dev UX could swallow the warning when in_array(env, ['local','testing']).
improvements_deferred_to_v1_0_2.rationale_defer: Cosmetic dev-only friction; production deploys with cloud Pusher work today.

improvements_deferred_to_v1_0_2.concern: No bulk-select multi-toggle UI (M1 simplification chose binary single-toggle). Owner accepted, but for chef rush scenarios a 'Toggle ALL in this bucket OFF' button could shave 5-10 clicks during inventory shocks.
improvements_deferred_to_v1_0_2.rationale_defer: Per Mission 1 owner spec 2026-05-21, the V2 unified browser intentionally drops bulk-select (V1 had it, was confusing). Backlog if owner re-requests.

q9s1_listener_wiring_sentinel.interpretation: Both ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged and ItemVariationAvailabilityChanged still wire InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange (per commit a68acb20f). The wiring is bit-identical to the fix at EventServiceProvider.php L204-225.

nf525_audit_chain_impact.rationale: Stock rupture toggles do NOT write audit_logs or z_reports. They write item_branch_availability and stock_levels (operational tables). No HMAC chain mutation.
